sections.h1: Reach is easy to buy and hard to turn into pipeline
lead: A creator with a large audience can still send you nobody who buys. We pick creators for fit with your buyers, brief them properly and measure what they bring in.

sections.h2: Influencer Marketing & Social Management: what is included

p: Shortlists built from audience fit, content quality and past brand work, not follower count alone.
Clear deliverables, usage rights, approval steps and payment terms agreed before anything is published.
Paid partnerships labelled as the platforms and advertising rules in your market require.
Day-to-day publishing, community replies and reporting for the channels where your buyers are.
LinkedIn voices and industry experts for business audiences, and consumer creators for retail and lifestyle.
Tracked links and codes tied to leads and sales, reported next to your other channels.
Agree who you need to reach and what action counts as success.
Vet creators against that buyer and check their audience before outreach.
Set deliverables, rights, disclosure and tracking in writing.
Manage content approvals, publishing and the social channels around the campaign.
Report against the agreed action and keep the creators who delivered it.
Influence often works before the click. Tracked links and codes capture part of it, and we say how much of the result we can and cannot trace.

a: We start from your buyer, then check audience fit, content quality and past brand work. Follower count is one input and not the deciding one.

faq.q: Do you manage our social accounts too?
a: Yes. Social media management and influencer programmes can run as one engagement or separately.
Through tracked links, discount codes and landing pages tied to leads and sales, reported alongside your other channels.

faq.q: How is this different from your social media marketing service?
a: Social media marketing covers your own channels and content. This service adds paid creator partnerships and their management.
